summary: Milestone Scientific Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that three directors elected to convert remaining principal and accrued interest from amended and restated convertible bridge notes into common stock. Outstanding amounts: $116,495.47 to Casamento, $58,247.73 to Demesmin, $291,238.66 to Goldman. Conversions are automatic once common stock fair value is at least $0.50 per share and holders can trade under the insider trading policy. No shares have been issued yet. This is a routine note conversion, not a special situation; no deal terms, premium, or strategic event involved.
